description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'UtilXml' providing static methods for XML processing, including parsing, serialization, DOM manipulation, validation, and helper functions for handling XML documents, elements, attributes, and errors within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilXml.LocalResolver
classes.description: EntityResolver implementation that resolves DTDs from local resources or properties to avoid external network calls during parsing.

classes.name: UtilXml.LocalErrorHandler
classes.description: ErrorHandler implementation that logs XML parsing errors, warnings, and fatal errors, especially when DTDs are involved.

methods.name: getDomLsImplementation
methods.description: Obtains a DOMImplementationLS instance supporting Load and Save features.

methods.name: createLSOutput
methods.description: Creates an LSOutput object configured with optional OutputStream and encoding.

methods.name: createLSSerializer
methods.description: Creates an LSSerializer with configured output properties such as XML declaration and pretty printing.

methods.name: writeXmlDocument
methods.description: Serializes a DOM Node to an OutputStream as XML, with options for encoding, declaration, and formatting.

methods.name: transformDomDocument
methods.description: Serializes a DOM Node to an OutputStream using a provided Transformer.

methods.name: createOutputTransformer
methods.description: Creates a Transformer configured for pretty-printed XML output with specified encoding and indentation.

methods.name: fromXml
methods.description: Deserializes an object from XML using XStream from various input sources.

methods.name: toXml
methods.description: Serializes an object to an XML string or to an OutputStream/Writer.

methods.name: readXmlDocument
methods.description: Parses XML content from String, URL, or InputStream into a DOM Document, with optional validation and position tracking.

methods.name: makeEmptyXmlDocument
methods.description: Creates a new empty DOM Document optionally with a specified root element.

methods.name: addChildElement
methods.description: Creates and appends a child Element with a given name to a parent Element.

methods.name: addChildElementValue
methods.description: Creates and appends a child Element and adds a text value to it.

methods.name: childElementList
methods.description: Returns a list of child Elements of a specified name or set of names.

methods.name: getNodeNameIgnorePrefix
methods.description: Returns the local name of a node, ignoring any namespace prefix.

methods.name: getTagNameIgnorePrefix
methods.description: Returns tag name of an Element, ignoring namespace prefix.

methods.name: elementValue
methods.description: Returns the concatenated text content of an Element and its CDATA or Text children.

methods.name: elementAttribute
methods.description: Returns the value of a specified attribute from an Element, with default if absent.

methods.name: convertDocumentToXmlString
methods.description: Transforms a DOM Document into a pretty-printed XML string.

methods.name: createApacheLicenceComment
methods.description: Generates a Comment node containing the ASF license header.
